lines.say: This is the cooling loop, seen from above.
lines.show: This is the cooling loop, seen from above.

lines.say: Every four S U pod carries its own C D U and pump at the wall end.
lines.show: Every 4SU pod carries its own CDU and pump at the wall end.

lines.say: That pump sends hot water-glycol through the inner wall and into the store.
lines.show: That pump sends hot water-glycol through the inner wall and into the store.

lines.say: Sixty-four pods put thirty-two megawatts of heat into the store this way.
lines.show: 64 pods put 32 MW of heat into the store this way.

lines.say: Outside, every dry cooler has a pump of its own.
lines.show: Outside, every dry cooler has a pump of its own.

lines.say: It draws liquid out of the store, cools it, and returns it cold at the outer wall.
lines.show: It draws liquid out of the store, cools it, and returns it cold at the outer wall.

lines.say: So hot enters at the inner wall, and cold enters at the outer wall.
lines.show: So hot enters at the inner wall, and cold enters at the outer wall.

lines.say: The store between them lets heat collection and heat rejection run independently.
lines.show: The store between them lets heat collection and heat rejection run independently.
